summary: In Go's envconfig implementation, missing user config directory environment variables ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME and $HOME) cause failures instead of gracefully falling back, contrary to documentation. Need to verify and fix this behavior consistently across all SDKs.
userImpact: Users on systems without $XDG_CONFIG_HOME or $HOME defined encounter unexpected errors instead of gracefully falling back to no config file.
rootCause: envconfig fails when user config directory environment variables are not set, rather than treating this as 'no config file exists'
proposedFix: Handle the 'failed getting user config dir' error the same as 'no file exists' and verify this behavior is consistent across all SDKs
keyQuote: We should consider this error to be the same as 'no file exists'
